# Payhip

Payhip is an e-commerce platform that enables individuals and businesses to sell digital products, memberships, and physical goods directly to their audience.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/payhip/.

## Actions

- **Webhook Event - Paid** (read-only): Process payhip's paid webhook event.
- **Webhook Event - Refunded Payment** (read-only): Process payhip's refunded webhook event.
- **Webhook Event - Subscription Created** (read-only): Process payhip's subscription.created webhook event.
- **Webhook Event - Subscription Deleted** (read-only): Process payhip's 'subscription.deleted' webhook event.
